verdict.rationale: Kong's first-party docs describe a Dev Portal for publishing APIs from OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specs plus Markdown docs. Developers can browse and search documentation, try operations, and manage their own credentials, and the portal can be made private with authentication for internal audiences. Konnect Catalog adds an org-wide inventory of APIs and API packages so teams can find what already exists, and the Dev Portal can be managed via the official Terraform provider. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the portal and catalog experience, and clarity that these are Konnect (SaaS) features rather than part of the OSS gateway.
